Dhanda nahi chal raha hai to kya upay karein? Customer aata hai, price poochta hai, aur bina kuch liye chala jaata hai. Aapka paisa teen jagah chhoot raha hai, aur teeno theek karne mein ek rupaya bhi nahi lagta. 😬

1. Price batate time: ek rate mat bataiye, teen options dijiye. Zyada tar log beech wala lete hain.

2. Jab customer bole "soch ke batata hoon": bas poochiye, kis baat pe sochna hai? Price pe, ya kuch aur? Asli reason yahin pata chalta hai.

3. Bill banate time: "aur kuch?" mat poochiye. Seedha suggest kijiye, ye saath mein badhiya chalta hai.

Dukaan ho, salon ho, clinic ho, ya consulting. Ye teeno kal se try kijiye. Comment mein bataiye, kaun sa sabse zyada kaam aaya 👇
